summary: Huge AI day: Jensen Huang has actually resigned as Nvidia CEO — a major escalation from yesterday's 'board preparing to oust' reporting — alongside Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch and a Microsoft Outlook outage. That non-phone news is too big and too fast-moving to trim, so phone comes in at 5/10 (50%) today, well under the usual 70% target; phone itself was a genuinely quiet day (US carrier news, a market-share stat, minor leaks) rather than thin because of neglect.

topics.working_title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO Amid Affair Scandal
topics.why_now: This is a confirmed resignation, not just board deliberation — TechCrunch, The Verge, Android Authority and Techmeme (citing NYT/Reuters) report Huang is out, Colette Kress is interim CEO, Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, a third affair has been reported, and Trump has floated Tim Cook as a successor. This is a material escalation from Memeburn's Nov 8 and our Nov 12 brief's 'board preparing to oust' coverage — lead with what's new: he's actually out.
topics.angle: One clear update-style piece: confirm the resignation and interim leadership, summarize the scandal timeline in two sentences for readers catching up, and cover the two live threads readers will search for — who becomes permanent CEO, and what Congress wants from him.
headline_options: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO Amid Affair Scandal
Jensen Huang Is Out at Nvidia — Here's What Happens Next

sources.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid mounting scandals
Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang's successor

topics.notes_for_writer: Fast-moving story with multiple sourced-to-anonymous-sources claims (third affair, Trump's comments) — attribute each claim to its outlet, don't blend them into one confirmed narrative. Link back to our Nov 8 and Nov 12 coverage for readers following along. Tim Cook as successor is Trump 'floating' an idea, not a nomination — don't headline it as likely.

topics.working_title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, and It's Already Beating Its Bigger Sibling

topics.angle: Two-part story: what Gemini 4 Hydrogen actually changes for everyday Search users (better answers to complex questions), plus the benchmark angle for the more technical reader — where it lands against Sonnet 5.5 and Sol on price-to-performance.
headline_options: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, and It's Already Beating Its Bigger Sibling
Gemini 4 Hydrogen Is Here — Here's What Changes in Google Search
